_comment: Per-page metadata + script sets for tools/sync_pages.py. 'plugins': splittext | flip (GSAP core, ScrollTrigger and Lenis load everywhere). 'data': extra data files. 'scripts': page scripts after motion.js. 'noindex': adds a robots meta. 'canonical': false = no canonical/og:url (404).
